title: Butterfly dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='wingL' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8a3d'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ff4f8b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b03ce0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wingR' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8a3d'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ff4f8b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b03ce0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- upper wings -->
  <path d='M48 44 C34 22 12 16 8 30 C4 44 20 52 44 50 Z' fill='url(#wingL)'/>
  <path d='M52 44 C66 22 88 16 92 30 C96 44 80 52 56 50 Z' fill='url(#wingR)'/>

  <!-- lower wings -->
  <path d='M48 52 C36 62 16 68 16 80 C16 92 34 90 46 74 Z' fill='url(#wingL)' opacity='0.92'/>
  <path d='M52 52 C64 62 84 68 84 80 C84 92 66 90 54 74 Z' fill='url(#wingR)' opacity='0.92'/>

  <!-- wing spots -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='32' r='5.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='32' r='5.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='78' r='3.8' fill='#8ef0ff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='78' r='3.8' fill='#8ef0ff'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='5' ry='16' fill='#2b1a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='3' ry='12' fill='#6b4fa8'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='5' fill='#2b1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='3.2' fill='#6b4fa8'/>

  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M48 32 C44 22 40 18 36 15' stroke='#8ef0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 32 C56 22 60 18 64 15' stroke='#8ef0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='14' r='2.6' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='14' r='2.6' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='52' r='2' fill='#8ef0ff'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='52' r='2' fill='#8ef0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
